text: {"covered": [{"point_id": "q5a_organization", "quote": "File organization is the way records are arranged and stored on a storage medium so that they can be accessed and processed efficiently."}, {"point_id": "q5a_reorganization", "quote": "File re-organization is the process of restructuring an existing file to restore efficiency, for example removing deleted records or rebuilding indexes."}, {"point_id": "q5b_serial", "quote": "The four methods are serial, sequential, indexed and random file organization."}, {"point_id": "q5b_sequential", "quote": "The four methods are serial, sequential, indexed and random file organization."}, {"point_id": "q5b_indexed", "quote": "The four methods are serial, sequential, indexed and random file organization."}, {"point_id": "q5b_random", "quote": "The four methods are serial, sequential, indexed and random file organization."}]}
